page.overview:
Who is Ambrose Lucifera?

Ambrose Lucifera was a member of House Lucifera.

Ambrose Lucifera was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull. They told him that they were delivering a gift from a secret admirer and he asked to know who it was. They replied that their patron did not wish to spoil the romance and offered him Caladan wine. He joyously accepted it and asked if they wished to share it, to which they replied that the patron insisted that he enjoy it alone. Little did he know, it was infected with tainted spice.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
